CustomField.description: The Payment Amount this payment was created with, copied once by OppPaymentTrigger (PaymentAmountService) and never changed. Compared with the Payment Amount to show an underpayment when a smaller amount is marked Paid. Deliberately kept off page layouts and record pages, and read-only for the JCRC profiles, so it is not overwritten. Author: Jason Ott.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The amount this payment was originally scheduled for. Set automatically when the payment is created.
CustomField.label: Original Payment Amount
